ffff_framework.findings_goal: 0x_spawn_template.py currently writes 4 fields (task_id, timestamp, dashboard_line, next_task_queued); MISSING 7 fields that agents need to emit
ffff_framework.flags_goal: CRITICAL: quality_score, belief_index fields not computed anywhere → manifests cannot gate via compass edges → phase gates broken system-wide
ffff_framework.flow_goal: Downstream agents cannot trust manifest quality → discovery protocol fails → compass navigation stalls → missions pile up in NORTH edge (unblocked prerequisites forever)
ffff_framework.friction_goal: Quality gate at 0.70 is unenforced → bad work proceeds to south edge → causes rework downstream → FFMx tanks

critical_context.audit_finding: 7 CRITICAL violations: quality_score, belief_index, dashboard_line, discovered_work, honey_version_used, honey_rendering_context, honey_render_fidelity are UNUSED in manifests
critical_context.root_cause: 0x_spawn_template.py (the spawn-contract enforcer) doesn't compute these fields
critical_context.system_impact: BLOCKS all downstream missions: phase gates don't work, compass edges not validated, FFMX metrics unreliable

fields_to_wire: belief_index (average of 4 honesty signals: self-admission of uncertainty, prior-session accuracy, manifest truthfulness, cross-citation fidelity)
discovered_work (array of task_ids found via frontier scan)
honey_render_fidelity (quality score of HONEY rendering itself)
implementation_scope.phase_gate_logic: IF (quality_score ≥ 0.70 AND belief_index ≥ 0.70) THEN compass_edge=S ELSE IF (quality_score ≥ 0.70 AND belief_index < 0.70) THEN compass_edge=E ELSE IF (belief_index ≥ 0.70 AND quality_score < 0.70) THEN compass_edge=W ELSE compass_edge=N

success_criteria.all_manifests: Every manifest written on or after fix includes all 11 required fields
success_criteria.phase_gate_validation: New manifests with compass_edge=N/S/E/W are routable; agents respect compass edges in frontier scan
success_criteria.backward_compatibility: Old manifests still readable; new schema doesn't break COC chain
success_criteria.compass_edge: S if all manifests pass validation; N if discovery reveals more blockers
